location.ref: Die to Live, on dying daily

paraphrase: Meditation is the practice of dying while living: withdrawing the attention from the body to the eye centre as at death, the disciple learns daily to cross the threshold, and so no longer fears death.
speaker: Charan Singh
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
notes: Skeleton from memory (Phase B). Sant Mat teaching (recent); locator at book/part level only.

location.ref: Die to Live, on the Master at the disciple's death

paraphrase: At the death of an initiate the Master comes to receive the soul himself; the angel of death has no power over him.
speaker: Charan Singh
translation_basis: paraphrase from memory of the vernacular text (Phase B skeleton); to be checked against an edition in Phase D
